sources.excerpt: Beryl EVR – Leqtiqueshop Skip to content Submit Close search Leqtiqueshop Submit Search Log in Cart Beryl EVR Regular price $210.00 Sale Default Title - Sold out Quantity Sold out Beryl EVR Gallery This OD/DS, released as Leqtique - Beryl in 2018, is undoubtedly the most versatile effect pedal in Leqtique's past works. Its four main functions -- Clean (Preamp EQ), Low Gain OD, Medium Gain OD, and Medium Gain DS -- can be adjusted continuously, so unless you need ultra-high gain settings like 9/9-10/10-11/11, and you need one unit to produce every sound, the Beryl EVR or RED EVR are undoubtedly the best choices. The RED EVR has a stronger treble than the Leqtique - RED, which makes it a little closer to the Beryl, but I still think its greatest strength is its medium-high gain distortion sound, so although it is certainly versatile, it is also very different, including in terms of the difference in tone. The Beryl's original Gain knob setting varied the gain of two stages, each controlled by a separate gain stage. The first stage used a vintage clipping diode to create an extremely smooth overdrive sound reminiscent of the MAR. The second stage used a green LED with a high threshold as a clipper, adding a wild, rough-edged distortion as the gain range increased. Although more than half of the constants in the circuit of this Beryl EVR have been changed, there is no significant change in the target sound or variable range, but the distortion component added as the gain of the second stage is increased has been adjusted to a slightly more open and rough sound. This modification further brings out the clear and high-centered sound that is inherent to the Beryl. As time goes by, the number of transparent effects has increased, but the common usage is to use them as a Preamp/EQ/Boost(+) with a slight gain push rather than as a standalone distortion. The Beryl EVR, like the original Beryl, fully covers that range, while emphasizing the individuality and usefulness of standalone distortion with a modern sound image. Among Leqtique's products, which tend to have a dark sound, the Beryl and 11/11 are models that were designed with a strong awareness of the significance of treble and presence from the very beginning, and although they are quite unique in a way, if you want a single unit that can handle a variety of tasks smoothly, but also want a unique tone in each gain range, then this is the best choice among EVR products, both before and after. Shun Nokina About the "EVR" concept Since 2019, I have been based in Europe and have been involved in the design of several pedals, but the Leqtique pedal line has essentially been on hiatus without releasing any new products. However, by temporarily moving my base to Iceland in 2024, I was able to gain some wonderful inspiration, and have continued to design all of them as an updated package called "EVR." "EVR" is the Icelandic word for Europe. The letters strongly evoke the idea that the pedals embody the inspiration and experiences gained over many years of traveling and living in various parts of Europe. The Leqtique pedals originally embodied a strong desire for Europe, with their vibrant paintwork and dark sound, but now they are more clearly embodied as a more real-world experience. Leqtique pedals, which have not received an update in 15 years, have been completely redesigned from the ground up, including the housing, all components, and concept. For example, the housing, which was previously a one-piece machined aluminum body, has been redesigned from a standard "box" design with a wide tolerance range, but has been completely redesigned specifically for the Leqtique EVR pedal. By rethinking the advantages of a one-piece design, the previously aluminum-only construction has been divided and integrated into three sections: a functional aluminum base case, a non-magnetic stainless steel cosmetic layer, and individually machined parts.
